entity: Mississippi hospitals' death rates versus the national rate
what_we_add: the hospital-level count: 24 of 72 worse, 1 better, and the four-state 43-worse-vs-4-better with look-alike expectations of 20 and 25
why: MPB and Commonwealth Fund name Mississippi and state the same finding in words: worst hospital Medicare mortality in the nation, 16.5% vs 14.4%. No source counts hospitals flagged worse, which is our headline number.
